name: classloop
description: ClassLoop desktop and mobile-web classroom follow-up platform
author: ClassLoop <classloop.donotreply@gmail.com>

scripts.test:mcp: npm run build:mcp && node tests/mcp-smoke.test.mjs && node tests/composio-manifest.test.mjs
scripts.test:security: node scripts/security-baseline.cjs && node tests/api-security.test.mjs && node tests/supabase-policy.test.mjs
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:import && npm run test:cloud && npm run test:entitlements && npm run test:mcp && npm run test:security
scripts.verify:ci: npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test:unit && npm run test:coverage:import-cloud && npm run audit:prod && git diff --check
scripts.test:browser:critical: node scripts/run-playwright.cjs tests/browser/classloop.spec.ts --project=chromium --grep "public Upgrade to Pro|cloud signup confirmation|live capture modes stay locked|Stripe payment link starts checkout"
scripts.deploy:prod:verify: npm run deploy:prod && npm run verify:deploy:assets && npm run test:web
scripts.test:all: npm run build && npm run test:security && npm run test:package:init && npm run test:package:sync && npm run test:import && npm run test:cloud && npm run test:entitlements && npm run test:mcp && npm run test:stripe && npm run test:browser && npm run test:web:local && npm run test:swift:mac && npm run test:desktop:state && npm run test:desktop:first-run && npm run test:release:distribution && npm run drill:rollback && npm run drill:incidents && npm run test:manual:write && git diff --check
scripts.drill:ops: npm run drill:rollback && npm run drill:incidents
scripts.package: npm run package:prepare && npm run package:mac:prepared
scripts.package:all: npm run package:prepare && npm run package:mac:prepared && npm run package:win:prepared && npm run package:linux:prepared
scripts.package:mac: npm run package:prepare && npm run package:mac:prepared
scripts.package:mac:electron: npm run package:prepare && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64
scripts.swift:mac:build: npm run package:prepare && npm run package:mac:prepared
scripts.swift:mac:package: npm run package:prepare && npm run package:mac:prepared
scripts.swift:mac:run: npm run package:prepare && CLASSLOOP_SWIFT_LOCAL_DIST=$PWD/dist swift run --package-path macos-swift/ClassLoopSwift ClassLoopSwift
scripts.package:win: npm run package:prepare && npm run package:win:prepared
scripts.package:linux: npm run package:prepare && npm run package:linux:prepared
